skill.name: pdf-analyze
skill.description: Process PDFs with practical recipes and helper scripts for text extraction, table extraction, image conversion, page operations, and form filling.
skill.summary: Analyze, transform, and fill PDF documents using Python libraries and command-line PDF tools.
skill.author: 21pounder

security_audit.summary: Static findings were reviewed against source context. The external-command alerts are Markdown fences, inline formatting, JavaScript template literals, or documented shell examples, and the network alerts are comment-only reference URLs. The remaining file-system writes are expected PDF input and output behavior with no evidence of prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration.

remediation.suggestion: Warn users to write generated PDFs and images to a new output directory or filename, not over originals.
Document required packages and external tools before running examples, including pypdf, pdf2image, poppler-utils, qpdf, and pdftk.

content.value_statement: PDF workflows often require extraction, conversion, merging, and form filling across many documents. This skill provides practical Python and command-line recipes for repeatable PDF processing.
actual_capabilities: Extract text, tables, and metadata from PDFs with pypdf and pdfplumber examples.
Merge, split, rotate, watermark, and encrypt PDF pages using documented workflows.
Render PDF pages to PNG or JPEG images for visual review and OCR preparation.
Fill AcroForm fields with helper scripts and validated field values.
Add text annotations to non-fillable forms using bounding boxes and validation images.
Create new PDF documents with reportlab and pdf-lib examples.
limitations: Required Python packages and external PDF tools must already be installed.
Scanned documents need OCR tools, and image quality affects accuracy.
Form filling depends on correct field detection or manually verified bounding boxes.
Helper scripts read and write local files and can overwrite selected output paths.

use_cases.title: Prepare Intake Forms
use_cases.description: Fill client or employee PDF forms while preserving page layout and field structure.

use_cases.title: Review Document Packets
use_cases.description: Extract text, metadata, and tables from large PDF packets for faster review.

use_cases.title: Convert Scanned Records
use_cases.description: Render scanned PDFs into page images before OCR and visual quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Basic PDF Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-analyze to extract readable text and metadata from [file]. Summarize page count, title, author, and main sections.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a PDF for Visual Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-analyze to convert [file] into page images. Identify scanned pages and note pages that need OCR.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a PDF Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-analyze to check whether [form.pdf] has fillable fields. Prepare field values from [data] and create [output.pdf].

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-analyze to process all PDFs in [folder]. Extract tables, split attachments, convert scanned pages for OCR, and produce a concise audit report.

output_examples.input: A twenty-page invoice PDF with tables on pages two through eight.
output: Extracted table notes with likely headers and row counts.
A list of pages that need manual review.

output_examples.input: A fillable onboarding form and a list of approved field values.
output: Detected form fields with page locations.
Validated choices for checkboxes, radio groups, and lists.
A completed PDF saved to the requested output path.

output_examples.input: A scanned application PDF with no interactive form fields.
output: Page images for visual field placement.
Validation images showing entry and label boxes.
A filled PDF with text annotations placed in approved areas.

best_practices: Keep original PDFs unchanged and write outputs to clearly named new files.
Inspect validation images before placing annotations on non-fillable forms.
Confirm required libraries and PDF command-line tools before starting a workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not skip bounding box validation for non-fillable forms.
Do not rely on OCR results for critical fields without human review.
Do not overwrite source PDFs when testing extraction or form filling steps.

faq.question: Can this skill fill interactive PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes scripts to detect fillable fields, validate values, and write a completed PDF.

faq.question: Can it handle forms without fillable fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports image conversion, bounding box validation, and text annotations for non-fillable forms.

faq.question: Does it perform OCR by itself?
faq.answer: It provides OCR workflow guidance, but OCR depends on installed tools such as pytesseract and pdf2image.

faq.question: Can it extract tables from PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance uses pdfplumber and pandas examples to extract and combine tables.

faq.question: Does it require local file access?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows read input PDFs and write generated PDFs, images, or extracted data locally.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
